{{Quote|I've never seen a virus like this. I'm almost positive it was remotely activated—probably from Grievous's command ship as soon as we jumped into range. Whoever designed it—they're genius.|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Avrey]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
This '''computer virus''' was newly developed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Once the virus infiltrated the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], it could jam all communication systems of the same.

Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] deployed the virus for the first time, after a Confederate [[Agent/Legends|agent]] smuggled the virus aboard various ships of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. During the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]], he remotely activated the virus which jammed the whole communication between the Republic forces. The [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] continued their attack against the Confederate [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] and their [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] were able to restore communication by using older crystal bio-anode circuitry which were not affected by the virus. This forced the Confederate forces to withdraw.
